offering_description.value: Distributes plumbing, heating, ventilation and air conditioning products, waterworks, fire protection and industrial piping products. Sells to residential and commercial contractors, builders, municipalities and industrial customers through branches, distribution centers, showrooms and online, with delivery and technical support.

primary_products.value: plumbing fixtures and fittings; pipes, valves and fittings; HVAC equipment; waterworks products; fire protection products

primary_services.value: product delivery and logistics; showroom design assistance; technical and project support

customer_segment.value: B2B: residential and commercial plumbing and HVAC contractors, builders, waterworks contractors, industrial and facility maintenance customers; B2C: homeowners and remodelers buying through showrooms and online; B2G: municipalities and public works projects

end_markets.value: residential construction and repair; commercial construction; civil and infrastructure; industrial; facilities maintenance

revenue_model.value: product sales: resale of plumbing, HVAC, waterworks and fire protection products; service fees: delivery, project and technical support services

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys products from manufacturers and sells to contractors, builders, municipalities and industrial customers

geography_served.value: North America: United States primarily, plus Canada

specialization.value: related lines: plumbing, HVAC, waterworks, fire and fabrication, and industrial products sharing contractor customers and channels

distribution_channels.value: own locations: branches, distribution centers and showrooms; direct sales: outside sales to contractors and commercial accounts; online: e-commerce site and mobile app for contractors and consumers

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal business rules plus product standards such as water safety and lead-free requirements
